query:
SELECT
        t.id       AS "trade_id!",
        t.quantity AS "trade_qty!",
        tf.amount  AS "fee_amount!"
    FROM trade t
    JOIN trade_fee tf ON tf.trade_id = t.id
    WHERE t.id IN (
        SELECT source_trade_id
        FROM lot
        WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT lot_id FROM lot_close)
          AND source_trade_id IS NOT NULL
    )
